output_path.title: Output path
output_path.description: Service-relative key prefix that receives the Parquet files. For the fs service with root '/', an absolute path is accepted.

service.title: OpenDAL service
service.description: OpenDAL scheme, for example fs, s3, gcs, azblob, sftp, or memory. Defaults to fs.

settings_file.title: OpenDAL settings file
settings_file.description: JSON file with service, options, and optional Parquet settings. Relative paths resolve from the process working directory.

options.title: OpenDAL options
options.description: Service-specific OpenDAL options. Values are converted to strings. Inline values override environment variables and the settings file.

flush_row_limit.title: Flush row limit
flush_row_limit.description: Maximum number of buffered rows per stream before a Parquet object is written.

flush_on_state.title: Flush on state
flush_on_state.description: Flush buffered rows when a state message arrives. Keep enabled unless you accept that acknowledged state can arrive before the records are written.

file_name_template.title: File name template
file_name_template.description: Parquet object file name. Supported placeholders: {timestamp}, {sequence}, {uuid}, {stream}, and {namespace}. The name must end in .parquet and contain {sequence} or {uuid} so flushes do not overwrite each other.

compression.title: Compression
compression.description: Parquet compression codec. Defaults to the Parquet.Net default (snappy).

row_group_size.title: Row group size
row_group_size.description: Maximum number of rows per Parquet row group. Defaults to the Parquet.Net default.
